definitions.gloss: Sakurajima, the volcano in Kagoshima Bay
definitions.explanation: An active volcano in Kagoshima Bay in southern Kyushu, facing Kagoshima city across the water. It erupts small plumes of ash many times a year, and ash falling on the city is part of daily life; the volcano is the symbol of Kagoshima.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {桜島大根|さくらじまだいこん}: Sakurajima radish, a giant round variety grown in the volcanic soil
- {克灰袋|こくはいぶくろ}: the yellow bags Kagoshima residents use to collect volcanic ash for pickup
- {桜島|さくらじま}⟦フェリー→フェリー：11168_ferii⟧: the ferry linking the volcano to the city, running around the clock

CULTURAL NOTE:
Despite its name, Sakurajima is no longer an island: the great eruption of 1914 poured out so much lava that it joined it to the Ōsumi Peninsula.
